name: temple_of_malady_scry_top_and_mana
notes: P2b2dfac54f G4. Printed: 'When this land enters, scry 1. {T}: Add {B} or {G}.' Answering top keeps the library order. On the next turn the untapped Temple pays Sedge Scorpion's {G}, the second option of its mana choice. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act).
